title: Bellman operators, contraction and fixed points

chapters.text: Start with two guesses. Current value gap: 10; Fixed point: 4.
Apply one Bellman backup. Current value gap: 7.5; Fixed point: 4.
Repeat the same operator. Current value gap: 5.62; Fixed point: 4.
Watch the gap contract. Current value gap: 4.22; Fixed point: 4.
Approach one fixed point. Current value gap: 3.16; Fixed point: 4.
